data_fields.name: sample_period
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 game cycles (CharacterTickUpdatePeriodGc); 0.1 s per cycle at the default step

data_fields.name: max_satiety
data_fields.donor_constant: MaxSatiety from the pet form PetHungerCount; example value 1000 in the donor comment

data_fields.name: drain_per_metre_over_walk
data_fields.donor_constant: AnimalHungerFactor = 1000*9/(7680*4.5*0.1) = 2.604 as a global CVariable; code multiplies by 16 cycles; proposed as a per-creature row value

data_fields.name: food_calories_per_unit
data_fields.donor_constant: item Calories field of the food item

best_idea: A mount's food meter drains only for distance travelled above its walk speed (per-metre rate from the creature row), clamps at zero, and at zero flips one speed flag that slows the mount until it is fed.
decision_why: Frankendom has no mounts yet; a travel-fatigue meter fits open zones as server state (one ledger, server-verified), but the donor's food loop, its unit mismatch (100x against its own comment) and the AND gate must not be copied; the duel and the Pit do not need it.
acceptance: In an open zone, a mount run 500 m above walk speed (server test) drains the meter by 500 x the row's per-metre rate, and at zero the server reports run speed capped to walk; a unit test asserts that a 20 mm move along one axis only is charged.
